record_title: No-Hopf theorem for the serial AM2 model with distinct removal rates
provenance: Scientific derivation from the cited serial AM2 ordinary-differential-equation model; the determinant-trace proof and literature review are documented in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
limitations: The result rules out local Hopf bifurcation from equilibria but does not prove global convergence or exclude periodic orbits created by global mechanisms. It relies on the feed-forward serial AM2 structure and does not automatically extend to chemostat models with feedback, flocculation, mutualism, delay, or other non-triangular couplings.
